services.name: Cabana Rentals
services.desc: Whether you’re seeking a place to relax, celebrate, or simply elevate your day of fun, our Epic Cabana Packages offer the perfect retreat. But don’t wait-availability is limited, and these coveted spots fill up fast! Enjoy your own private seating area and personalized service in the heart of the action. Conveniently located near key attractions like waterslides, the activity pool, and Rascal’s Round-Up play area. Admission Passes: Not included with cabana rentals and must be purchased

blurb: Epic Waters is an indoor waterpark with a retractable roof allowing year-round use regardless of weather. Guests can enjoy water slides, wave pools, lazy rivers, and play areas. The park offers birthday party packages, cabana and preferred seating rentals, annual passes, and vacation packages including hotel stays and dining perks.
extraNote: 50% deposit required for birthday party bookings, non-refundable · Birthday party deposit is non-refundable · No refunds or rain checks offered for weather closures except temporary ride closures for lightning · Late arrival to birthday party does not extend party time or refund · All guests must be present to purchase tickets, no holding tickets for late arrivals
